faq-item.faq-q: Which vector databases do you specialize in?
faq-item.faq-a: I have deep production experience with Pinecone, Weaviate, and Qdrant. The choice depends on your scale, self-hosting needs, and latency requirements. I'll recommend the best fit for your use case during the architecture spec.

faq-item.faq-q: What is the difference between a vector DB engineer and a general RAG developer?
faq-item.faq-a: A vector DB engineer specializes in optimizing indexing, query performance, and hybrid search across platforms like Pinecone, Weaviate, and Qdrant. A general RAG developer may not have deep experience tuning these databases for production-scale retrieval. For mission-critical accuracy, a specialist is essential.

faq-item.faq-q: How much does it cost to hire a vector database engineer?
faq-item.faq-a: A scoped proof-of-concept typically starts at $1,500 to $4,000. A full production RAG chatbot with guardrails and deployment ranges from $8,000 to $30,000. Hourly consulting runs $75 to $150/hr.

faq-item.faq-q: Should I hire one vector DB engineer or a dedicated team?
faq-item.faq-a: For a single scoped RAG system, one experienced engineer is faster and more cost-effective. If your roadmap spans multiple concurrent AI projects needing sustained team capacity, a dedicated team provider like AtlasML is better suited.

faq-item.faq-q: How long does it take to build a RAG system?
faq-item.faq-a: A proof-of-concept takes 2 to 4 weeks. A full production RAG chatbot with guardrails, evaluation, and deployment takes 4 to 10 weeks depending on data complexity and integration scope with your chosen vector DB.
